reads_as: a shattered cartoon robot exploding apart under a blunt 'WHAT HAPPENED?' question
layout_map: Near-black dark-grid background spanning the full frame. Headline 'WHAT HAPPENED?' in white Inter-style bold ALL-CAPS across the top band, cells 1-4, baseline ~y70, spanning x40-x1240 nearly edge to edge. Hero object is a cracked/exploding white robot head with X-shaped dead eyes, centered cells 6-7-10-11, head center ~x600,y400, filling roughly the lower-center 45% of the frame with debris fragments flying off. Cluster of small glowing tech/language logos (Python, JS, npm, etc.) orbit the robot at cells 9, 11, 12, 14, 16, ~x250-x1100 in the y330-y560 band as accent confetti. No stat badge. Cyan glow bleeds off the robot against the dark substrate.
why_it_works: a recognizable 'AI/automation' avatar literally falling apart pairs with a bare question to force the curiosity gap
mimic_for: a hyped technology or tool visibly failing or breaking down; a 'what went wrong' reveal beat
title: AI Was Supposed to Replace Developers... Until It Couldn't

reads_as: a glowing electric cage trapping a figure inside, captioned 'THE VIBE TRAP'
layout_map: Dark near-black gridded background with faint ghost human silhouettes outlined at far left (cell 13) and far right (cell 16). Headline 'THE VIBE TRAP' in white bold ALL-CAPS across the top, cells 1-4, baseline ~y75, spanning ~x60-x1180. Hero object is a purple/violet neon wireframe cube cage with crackling electric edges, centered cells 6-7-10-11, cage center ~x600,y410, occupying about 40% of the frame in the center-lower zone. A small glowing figure and colored orbs sit trapped inside the cage. No stat badge. Purple electric glow radiates against the dark substrate.
why_it_works: the metaphor of being literally caged by a trendy practice creates dread and curiosity in one image
mimic_for: a tempting shortcut or trend framed as a trap; warning against a seductive-but-dangerous approach
title: Vibe Coding is a Trap (What Senior Devs See That You Don't)

reads_as: a thinking man surrounded by code icons, one icon X'd out under 'AI-PROOF SKILLS'
layout_map: Dark slate gridded background full frame. Headline 'AI-PROOF SKILLS' in white bold ALL-CAPS across the top, cells 1-4, baseline ~y75, spanning ~x50-x1190. Center-bottom holds a real man in glasses and a light kurta in a thinking/chin-touch pose, head ~x640,y430, occupying cells 10-11 and lower center, about 30% of frame. Ring of hand-drawn cyan/white code icons (</> code, cloud, brain, gears, database, htva tag) arranged around him at cells 9, 10, 12, 13, 16. A bold RED X strike crosses out the '</>' code-bracket icon at cell 7, ~x560,y210 — the single accent mark. Cyan line-art tone throughout.
why_it_works: the red X negating one skill while a human ponders sells 'which skills survive AI' as a sorting puzzle
mimic_for: a skills-that-survive / what-still-matters list; ruling one option out among several
title: AI Replaced 80% of Coding, Only These 5 Skills Are Left

reads_as: a bold 'NO BULLSH*T GUIDE' over three connected Step buttons ending in 'Step ??'
layout_map: Flat saturated orange/yellow background, no photo. Headline stacked across the top two-thirds: 'NO' in purple at cell 1 (~x60,y95) abutting 'BULLSH*T' in white ALL-CAPS cells 2-4 (~x300-x1230, baseline ~y110), then 'GUIDE' in white below at cells 5-6 (~x60,y230). Lower third holds a roadmap of three rounded purple buttons connected by dashed white arrows: 'Step 1' at cell 14 (~x180,y560), 'Step 2' at cell 15 (~x600,y560), 'Step ??' at cell 16 (~x1040,y560), arrows curving between them left to right. mimic_for: a step-by-step roadmap or guide reveal; a learning path where the endpoint is the hook
title: The Web Dev Roadmap I Wish I Had (No One Tells You This!)
